reconcile.note: Gill argues John's prison question was posed for his disciples' benefit, not his own doubt, since he already knew Jesus was the Son of God from the baptism.

discrepancy.note: Strauss concludes John's Gospel testimony that the Baptist proclaimed Jesus Messiah is unhistorical, given the Synoptic prison question.

quotes.text: From the foregoing considerations, it is inconceivable that John should ever have held and pronounced Jesus to be the Messiah: but it is easy to show how a belief that he did so might obtain, without historical foundation.
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined, §46 (1846), on Matthew 11:3 and John 1:34.
